task: Single-factor attribution of BBBP scaffold AUC gap versus MoleculeNet RF 0.714

protocol.scaler: Strict train-only StandardScaler for descriptor columns in every config
protocol.model: RandomForestClassifier(n_jobs=-1); n_estimators is the only model factor switched (500 -> 100 sklearn default)
protocol.bootstrap: 2000 stratified resamples of seed-42 test set; percentile 95% CI
protocol.attribution_rule: Every non-cumulative row changes exactly one field from baseline and refits the model

sources.paper_findings: Main text: all MoleculeNet datasets split 80/10/10; non-graph models use RDKit ECFP4 by default; Table 6 reports BBBP scaffold RF AUC 0.714; three runs after Gaussian-process hyperparameter tuning. The fetched main text does not state the fingerprint bit length; 1024 is tested as a candidate factor.
sources.deepchem_splitter_findings: ScaffoldSplitter.generate_scaffolds sorts scaffold groups by (len, first_index) reverse=True; split() fills 80/10/10 in that order. Our baseline instead shuffles equal-size scaffold groups with seed 42.

gap.interpretation: Single-factor deltas are not additive because factors interact; the cumulative row changes several factors at once and is a diagnostic, not a single-factor attribution. Replacing our shuffled-tie scaffold split with the exact current DeepChem deterministic split alone removes ~97.5% of the 0.2244 AUC gap, while bit length, tree count, dedup and feature composition contribute <=0.031 each.
